name: standing wall slide half squat hold
description: A wall-supported half squat held in place to build quad endurance with low joint stress.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.
